title: Military Standardization Handbook: Aluminum and Aluminum Alloys (MIL-HDBK-694A, 1966; cancelled)
status: evaluated and rejected; contributes no data
reason: The elevated-temperature tables (VIII-X) exist only as OCR of a scan whose rows and columns come out scrambled; values cannot be assigned to alloy, temper and temperature without manual transcription, which this pipeline does not do. The only prose service-temperature statement found concerns a casting alloy that is not in the dataset.
